title: S3 AccessDenied
keywords: s3 access denied accessdenied permission bucket object forbidden iam

steps.text: Confirm the request is ACTIVE and the bucket name matches its approved resource output.
Inspect the role policy: ListBucket uses the bucket ARN; object actions use the bucket ARN followed by /*.
On real AWS, inspect explicit denies in identity policies, bucket policies, permissions boundaries, and organization policies. Moto does not prove IAM enforcement.

title: Jenkins build failed or timed out
keywords: jenkins build failed failure pipeline queue timeout token authentication artifact

steps.text: Open the specific Jenkins build for this request and check its console output and result.json artifact.
Verify the job is named clouddesk and the API token belongs to a user permitted to build and read that job.
After a timeout, verify the original build has stopped before retrying. A retry creates a new plan and requires another approval.

title: Slack command timeout
keywords: slack slash command timeout acknowledgement ack socket connection envelope

steps.text: Acknowledge Slack interactions within three seconds; provisioning and model calls belong in the background worker.
Check the Socket Mode bridge is running and its local bridge token matches the backend configuration.
Verify the app is installed in the configured workspace and has commands and chat:write bot scopes.

title: Duplicate requests and conflicting keys
keywords: duplicate request retry idempotency key conflict repeated submitted

steps.text: Reuse the same Idempotency-Key when retrying the same creation payload after a network interruption.
A repeated key with the same payload returns the existing request; a different payload with that key is rejected with HTTP 409.
Use a new key only for an intentionally new sandbox. Inspect the audit trail before approving another request.

title: Expired sandbox cleanup failed
keywords: expired sandbox ttl cleanup delete destroy failed bucket resources retry scheduled

steps.text: Check the request expiry time and whether its status is DESTROY_QUEUED, DESTROYING, CLEANUP_FAILED, or DESTROYED.
Inspect the worker/provider logs. API mode removes objects before deleting its owned bucket and then removes its scoped IAM role.
Cleanup retries automatically up to five attempts. If exhausted, use the cleanup action after correcting the local provider problem.

title: Approval denied or plan changed
keywords: approval approver unauthorized forbidden role plan digest changed mismatch denied

steps.text: Use an approver API token or a Slack user ID explicitly listed in CLOUDDESK_SLACK_APPROVERS.
Refresh the request and inspect its current plan digest before approving; a stale digest is rejected.
Approval is allowed only in AWAITING_APPROVAL. Failed provisioning must be replanned and approved again.

title: Terraform init, plan, or apply failed
keywords: terraform init provider download lock plan apply failed stale state configuration

steps.text: Check the request-specific last-error.log in the local Terraform work directory and confirm the Moto endpoint is reachable.
Run terraform version and verify provider downloads are allowed. CloudDesk requires Terraform 1.13.5 or later within the 1.x series.
Never regenerate a plan inside the apply step. Replan through CloudDesk and review the new saved-plan digest.

title: Local model unavailable
keywords: ollama local model unavailable inference connection memory assistant fallback grounded

steps.text: Check Ollama is running locally and the model listed in CLOUDDESK_OLLAMA_MODEL has been downloaded.
If the model is unavailable, CloudDesk returns retrieved runbook steps and explicitly labels the response as extractive fallback.
The assistant selects existing runbook step IDs. It has no infrastructure execution tools and cannot approve or provision resources.
